market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading ~$80,087 on May 8, 2026. To hit $45,000 by Dec 31, 2026 would require a ~44% drop in 7.5 months. While BTC has seen drawdowns of this magnitude historically, current trend is consolidating in $79-82k range. Base rate for 44%+ drawdowns in 7-month windows is ~10-15%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or major exchange/regulatory event could trigger sharp drawdown.
